tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sa skya'i rje btsun yab chos mchog /rdo rje phur pa la brten pa'i/ /bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams len tshul/ /rgyud dang mi 'gal zab gnad bzhugs// na mo gu ru shrī badz+ra ku mā rā ya/ bdag dang 'gro kun byang chub bar/ /bla ma sangs rgyas chos tshogs la/ /skyabs su mchi'o lhag pa'i lha/ /rdo rje gzhon nu myur thob shog /tshar bdun sogs gdangs bcas/ 'gro kun badz+ra ku mā ra'i/ /go 'phang thob phyir zab mo'i lam/ /rdo rje gzhon nu'i rnal 'byor la/ /yid gnyis spangs te rtse gcig bsgom/ /tshar gsum sogs/ sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig /sdug bsngal dag dang bral bar shog /bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing / /chos kun mnyam nyid rtogs par shog /oṃ ma hā shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ dharma dhā tu badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ chos kun ma bcos dbyings nyid las/ /ma rtogs 'gro la snying rje'i mdangs/ /zung 'jug rang gnas rat+na yi/ /gzhal yas mtshan nyid kun tshang dbus/ /seng chen brgyad bteg rin chen khrir/ /pad nyi zla steng dbang phyug dang / /u ma byi bcing bsnol steng du/ /bdag gi phung khams skye mched la/ /sku bzhi ye shes rnam bzhi'i son/ /'debs mdzad drin can rtsa ba yi/ /bla ma dam pa gdul bya yi/ /'dod khro rmongs pa'i gnyen por ni/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku/ /mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal/ /rdo rje rtse dgu rtse lnga dang / /me phung 'bar ba rtse gsum rnams/ /g.yas g.yon gnyis gnyis phyag gis bsnams/ /mtha' gnyis phur 'dril sku che rags/ /mche gtsigs spyan gsum zlum zhing dmar/ /ral pa kham pa gyen du brdzes/ /glang lpags zhing chen g.yang gzhi gsol/ /stag gi pags pa'i 'og pags can/ /dkar dmar ljang nag sbrul gyis brgyan/ /dbu rgyan se ral rked chings dang / /phyag dang zhabs rnams rnam par spras/ /thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan/

/rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas/ /rak+ta zhag dang thal chen gyis/ /thig le zo ris tshom bur byas/ /sna tshogs rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan/ /zhabs bzhi g.yas bskum g.yon brkyangs nas/ /dbang phyug kha phub mgo bo dang / /u ma'i nu ma rab brdzes shing / /ye shes me dpung dbus na bzhugs/ /yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs sngo/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas 'khor lo/ /g.yon pas thod khrag yab la stob/ /gzig gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ /rus pa'i rgyan lngas sku la brgyan/ /thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan/ /skam po lnga bcus do shal byas/ /sbrul dang rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan/ /rak+ta zhag dang thal chen gyi/ /thig le zo ris tshom bur byas/ /zhabs gnyis g.yas g.yon brkyang bskum gyis/ /yab kyi g.yon nas 'khyud pas bzhugs/ /de mthar kun bzang rigs lnga sogs/ /dgongs brgyud pad+ma 'byung gnas sogs/ /rigs brgyud klu dbang la sogs pa/ /snyan brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams dang / /bka' brgyad la sogs sangs rgyas dang / /byang sems nyan rang chos srung dang / /nor lha kun kyang bcom ldan 'das/ /rdo rje gzhon nu'i rnam pas bskor/ /bdag 'gror mkhyen brtse nus pas dgongs/ /mngon sum lta bur lham mer bzhugs/ /hūm̐/ mtha' bral chos dbyings ngang nyid las/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis longs spyod rdzogs/ /sprul pa gang 'dul der ston sku/ /bla ma rdo rje gzhon nu nyid/ /gdung ba'i shugs kyis spyan 'dren na/ /sku gsung thugs yon phrin las kyi/ /rnam rol bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ snyigs 'gror brtse phyir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ gu ru badz+ra kī li kī la ya sa pā ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥ sprin ltar 'thibs bzhin byon nas kyang / /so so'i sku la thim pa yis/ /dam ye dbyer med mngon sum pa/ /bdag sogs gdul bya'i blo ngor bzhugs/ /bdag dang ma gyur sems can kun/ /rdo rje gzhon nu'i skur gsal bas/ /zhing rdul lus kyis phyag 'tshal zhing /

/'tshal dang 'tshal yul ro gcig gyur/ /pra da ban+dha naṃ ka ro mi/ /bdag pos yongs su ma bzung dang / /dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa'i sprin/ /kun bzang rnam sprul dgra gnyen dang / /bar ma'i 'gro ba bdag cag gis/ /gces 'dzin yul khang nor rdzas kun/ /zhen med bla ma kī la yar/ /'bul lo brtse bzhes dngos grub stsol/ /mchod yul sku mdun rang nyid ni/ /tha mal lus kyi lag g.yas kyi/ /ye shes ral gris thod pa bcad/ /mdun du rlung me thod skam gyi/ /sgyed pu gsum steng gan rkyal du/ dpral ba rang la bstan bzhag nang / /rkang pa g.yas g.yon lag g.yon dang / /thod 'phro'i gdong dang stod smad kun/ /phyi nang thams cad dum bur bskyur/ /rang sems rlung dang dbyer med lha/ /rdo rje gzhon nus rdzas byin rlabs/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥtha/ gsum/ thugs sprul lha mo thod thogs kyis/ /bdud rtsi so sor phul bas mnyes/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma mchod/ /rgyud gsum brgyud pa'i bla ma mchod/ /bka' brgyad sangs rgyas zhi khro mchod/ /byang sems longs sprul rnam rol mchod/ /nyan rang skur ston kun kyang mchod/ /mthu ldan bstan srung rgya mtsho mchod/ /dpal ster nor lha gter bdag mchod/ /rigs drug yi dam lhar gsal mchod/ /lan chags bu lon sha 'khon gnyer/ /kun kyang yi dam lhar gsal mchod/ /mchod 'os kun gyis dngos grub stsol/ /sbyin 'os sdig sgrib dag gyur cig /bdud bzhi nad gdon dgra bgegs kyi/ /lan chags bu lon byang gyur cig /bdud rtsi'i lhag ma snod bcas la/ /slar yang 'jig rten khams kun gyi/ /lcags kyu sgron me ye shes lnga/ /lhan cig rtsa ba'i bla mar 'bul/ /bde chen ye shes stsal du gsol/ /rgyas par na/ ye shes sku mchog nas/ byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /bar sgrub thabs bklags pas don 'grub bzhin/ yang na/ thog med 'khor bar ma rig las nyon gyis/

/bcas rang sdig ltung ci mchis 'gro kun gyi/ /sdig dang lhan cig mgon po'i spyan sngar bshags/ /bzod par gsol lo tshangs par stsal du gsol/ /phrin las rnam bzhi'i gang 'dul der ston la/ /rjes su yi rang 'gro kun don chen phyir/ /skal 'tshams chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /gdul byar bdud rtsi'i sgo mo dbye bar gsol/ /sprul pa'i sku rnams mi 'gyur rtag bzhugs nas/ /ma lus gdul bya'i re smon kun zhu zhing / /dge des lha mchog badz+ra kī la ya/ /sems can kun phyir myur du 'grub par shog /sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ /rdo rje de nyid rang bzhin las/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid/ /'bar ba'i sku yi dngos grub thob/ /de bzhin gsung thugs la'ang rigs 'gre zhing / dmigs pa ni rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku gsung thugs las 'bru gsum byung ba rang gi gnas gsum du thim pas bum gsang shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob par mos/ sangs rgyas sku gsung thugs ye shes/ /rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bo nyid/ /'bar ba'i khro bo mi bzad pa/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol/ /zhes 'bru gsum lhan cig gnas gsum thim pas dbang bzhi pa thob/ rtsa gsum mchog gsum kun gyi dngos/ /bla ma rdo rje gzhon nu yis/ /sku gsung thugs yon phrin las kyi/ /dngos grub ma lus bdag la zhugs/ /zhes bla ma rdo rje gzhon nu 'od sngon po'i tshul gyis rang la thim zhing bde stong zung 'jug phyag chen ngang du ji tsam gnas par mnyam par gzhag de las ldangs nas/ dge ba 'di yis mtha' yas sems can kun/ /bdud las rnam rgyal bar chad kun bcom nas/ /rdo rje gzhon nu mya ngan 'das pa yi/ /'bras bu byang chub nges par 'grub gyur cig /skye med chos sku'i rang bzhin rnam dag las/ /thugs dam dbang gis gzugs kyi skur sprul pa/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyi/ /skye shi med pa don gyi bkra shis shog

/ces 'di sa rgan kun blo la/ /gong dkar chos sde nam mkha' mdzod/ /phrin las rnam par rgyal ba yis/ /rdo rje gzhon nu'i bla ma'i lam/ /dgos zhes de don 'gal med sbyar// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ rdo rje phur pa la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams len tshul/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
